G-Schema handoff flagged: no FK from calculation_line_item to expense_rule (value snapshot only), category_key stable string not row id, engine_version on calculations, append-only history, shop_id denormalized onto every tenant table, webhook_event inbox table + shop.uninstalled_at, ON DELETE CASCADE + asserted row-count redaction. gates.notes: Data model + session storage review, dedicated-DB path (data_ownership=dedicated, not shared-saas -> no shared-data contract needed, this is a real schema review not a contract review). Fires per gates.md: 'Always (a datastore always exists)'. Reviewing structural design BEFORE any migration runs, per architect's G1.5 handoff notes in decisions/architecture-packet.md §8: no FK from calculation line items to expense rules (value-snapshot only), category_key as stable string not row id, append-only calculation history, engine_version on calculations, shop_id denormalized onto every tenant table, webhook_event inbox table (unique index on webhook_id for dedup) + shop.uninstalled_at, cascade-delete + asserted row-count verification on redaction, session storage table (shopify_sessions) library-managed with no app columns. Routed to shopify-developer to produce data-model.md + draft migration DDL for review; no migration to be applied against any real database until this gate passes. | DEVELOPER PROPOSAL (PROPOSED, not approved - awaiting Tech lead decision): 7 tables (shop, expense_rule, calculation, calculation_line_item, webhook_event, compliance_audit_log, shopify_sessions[library-managed]). No expense_category table - recommended code constant EXPENSE_CATEGORIES keyed by category_key instead (avoids seed drift + the 'undeleteable global row' problem under GDPR redaction), backed by a DB CHECK constraint as runtime backstop. All 12 architect constraints from G1.5 satisfied: no FK line-items->rules (value snapshot), stable category_key, engine_version on calculations, append-only (BEFORE UPDATE trigger + DELETE still allowed for redaction cascade), currency per calculation, shop_id denormalized on every tenant table, webhook_event inbox with unique webhook_id dedup, shop.uninstalled_at, cascade-delete + row-count-assertion redaction, money as BIGINT minor units / INTEGER basis-point rates (no float columns), PostgreSQLSessionStorage confirmed with zero app-owned columns on shopify_sessions. 3 judgment calls flagged for Tech lead review (not silent decisions): (1) compliance_audit_log intentionally has NO shop_id - survives shop deletion as GDPR evidence trail, looks like a violation of the shop_id-everywhere rule but is a deliberate exception; (2) webhook_event.shop_id is NOT NULL, late-delivery-after-redaction edge case handled by repository-layer skip rather than nullable column; (3) possible tension between FT-08's literal 'zero webhook_event rows' wording and ADR-0002's delete-last-or-mark-then-purge guidance for the redact handler's own in-flight row - flagged before a fitness test gets written against an ambiguous spec. Artifacts: decisions/data-model.md (full schema + reasoning + ER-as-text), decisions/migrations/00000000000001-initial-schema.js (DRAFT/UNAPPLIED, reversible up/down, syntax-checked only, never run against any database - none exists yet, no npm project scaffolded). Shopify Dev MCP validation not run: task was generic PostgreSQL/Sequelize DDL with no Admin GraphQL/Polaris/webhook-handler code - orchestrator concurs this falls outside the MCP-evidence requirement for this specific deliverable (no commit, no PR, no Code-Review/QA routing - this is a Human design-gate artifact, not implementation). | DECISION: CONFIRM by sales@webdesksolution.ca on 2026-09-18T07:12:13Z. Schema baseline accepted as proposed (7 tables, code-constant categories, all 3 flagged judgment calls accepted as proposed defaults - no override given).
